answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after depositing a bond that is slashed if their identities coordinate to approve a fraudulent claim. A randomly sampled set of established agents checks each claim against independent evidence; rewards go to reviewers whose judgments match later audits, while colluding bonds are forfeited. An attacker must therefore buy many scarce bonds and risk losing them, not merely mint accounts. A harbor claim, terrace permit, or lotus shipment follows the same costly review path.
